hold_reason: Refund mismatch on order 181: the signed batch requested 17092 cents, but the ledger shows only 1851 cents applied (a 15241 cent gap). Orders 180 and 184 match. Paying net balances now would overpay the affected customer, so the batch needs human review before any payouts are recorded.
